reveal.summary: The Sixth Sense. Philadelphia is the setting, ghosting is the pun, Die Hard is Bruce Willis, the child actors point to Haley Joel Osment, and Muriel's Wedding is Toni Collette before the minivan scene. The line is Anna's — from the anniversary dinner where Malcolm is late in more ways than one.
reveal.ohMoment: Every answer was circling one table in an Italian restaurant — where a wife has dinner alone on her anniversary.
